def semver_sort(versions):
    def parse_version(version):
        # Split by '+' first to remove build metadata
        version_without_build = version.split('+')[0]
        
        # Split by '-' to separate core version and pre-release
        parts = version_without_build.split('-', 1)
        core = parts[0]
        prerelease = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else None
        
        # Parse core version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH)
        core_parts = core.split('.')
        major = int(core_parts[0])
        minor = int(core_parts[1]) if len(core_parts) > 1 else 0
        patch = int(core_parts[2]) if len(core_parts) > 2 else 0
        
        # Parse pre-release identifiers
        prerelease_identifiers = []
        if prerelease:
            prerelease_identifiers = prerelease.split('.')
        
        return (major, minor, patch, prerelease_identifiers)
    
    def prerelease_sort_key(identifiers):
        # A version with no pre-release sorts after one with pre-release
        # So we return False (which sorts before True) if there's a pre-release
        if not identifiers:
            return (True,)  # No pre-release, sorts after
        
        # With pre-release, convert each identifier
        key = []
        for identifier in identifiers:
            if identifier.isdigit():
                # All-digit identifiers sort numerically and before others
                key.append((0, int(identifier)))
            else:
                # Non-digit identifiers sort by ASCII order after digit identifiers
                key.append((1, identifier))
        return (False, tuple(key), len(identifiers))
    
    def sort_key_func(item):
        version_str, original_index = item
        major, minor, patch, prerelease = parse_version(version_str)
        return (major, minor, patch, prerelease_sort_key(prerelease), original_index)
    
    # Add original index to maintain stable sort for equal precedence
    indexed_versions = [(v, i) for i, v in enumerate(versions)]
    sorted_versions = sorted(indexed_versions, key=sort_key_func)
    
    return [v for v, _ in sorted_versions]
